prompt: The dial/touch input on the communicator feels laggy and the animation hitches roughly once a second. I want buttery-smooth, consistent frame times. Profile this and tell me what to change, ranked by impact.

assertions.text: Prioritizes consistency (frame-time variance) over average fps in the ranking
Connects input/dial latency to the LVGL lock / render stall
Identifies a plausible ~1 Hz periodic cause (e.g. rssi_task blocking SDIO poll, or the BLE list teardown/rebuild) with file:line
Recommends core affinity (pin LVGL vs radio/background tasks) as a consistency fix
Includes a before/after measurement plan using the FPS HUD
